summary: Iteration 66 tested Rapid Fire Phase 4 fixes against the public URL, using the QA learner 7004186276 for the UI and throwaway TEST-i65 users for pytest. Backend: 14/14 tests pass. That is the 11 existing tests in phase3, phase4 and iter65, plus 3 new ones in test_iter66_crown_guard_lead.py covering CROWN #2 (title_no/my_crown), night_guard 409 on both create and join, and the night-only 30 s lead-in (round 1 starts 28 s later than in a normal cup). Frontend: the HIGH crown bug is fixed. I won the final by DB while on the duel/result screen; no modal showed there and no rf.crown key was written. Going back to the cup showed the modal (FIRST CROWN / You are a Cup Champion! / SILVER CROWN · 1 CUP). After Continue the key was stored, and a reload showed no modal. A second real cup win showed CROWN #2 / Champion again! / SILVER CROWN · 2 CUPS. SEE MY CROWN opens the profile (×2 crown) and marks the cup seen. The modal scrolls at 320x568 and Continue is reachable; at 375x667 everything fits. The Cup Night banner works at 320/375/390 on the lobby and the hub: kicker 'DAILY · 8:00 PM', the line wraps to 2 lines at 320 with nothing cut off, and on the hub it is above cup-hero. All night phases worked in the UI: doors/join, the in-panel, the in-window banner 'YOU’RE IN ✓ · Starts in 1:07', the guard error on FIND A CUP, LIVE NOW → auto-route to the night duel, and the night-missed panel. The entry flash peaks at 0.264 white opacity at about 1.26 s and the Colosseum stays visible. Trophy ranks work. FAILED: the client.ts session-race fix does not cover the real cause. A hard load of /rapid/cup/<cid> still shows 'Your Rapid Fire session could not be verified. Please sign in again.' from about 1.5 s to 3.0 s while the backend returns 200. I reproduced it on every one of 5 reloads. No deprecated Expo packages were found. The QA profile and all created data were restored and removed.

ui_bugs.issue: A hard reload of /rapid/cup/<cid> shows ErrorBox 'Your Rapid Fire session could not be verified. Please sign in again.' for about 1.5 s (reproduced 5/5). /api/jl/auth/session and POST /api/rf/access both return 200 with the correct user_id. RCA: SessionBoundary keeps private screens mounted while auth is still verifying, and useAuth().user starts as null, so uid is ''. useFocusEffect in [cid].tsx:104 calls load() without a uid guard, so it calls rf('/cups/x', ''). rapidAccess('') gets the real user_id back, fails the check result.user_id !== userId at client.ts:303, and throws. When uid arrives, the poll effect's load() calls rapidAccess(uid), which awaits the same failed grantFlight (client.ts:293), and that rejection reaches it too. The valid token is thrown away, and only the next 2 s poll recovers (a second /rf/access at about 3.3 s). The generation-change check at line 304 comes after the throw, so it never helps here.

issues: The 'SEE MY CROWN' label is cut to 'SEE MY CRO…' (crown-celebration-see).
The 'JOIN CUP NIGHT' footer button is cut to 'JOIN CUP NIG…' (night-join).
During the new 30 s lead-in the duel screen shows a static 'Get ready…' for about 12 s before the entry show, with no number counting down. Consider showing the seconds left.

If a player who already has a gold crown wins a practice-rival cup, the art and rays are silver (gold = this cup's real_players > 1) but the chip says 'GOLD CROWN · N CUPS'. This may be intended, but it reads as inconsistent.

action_items: HIGH: fix the transient session error on hard load. (1) In app/rapid/cup/[cid].tsx, make load() return early when !uid, and audit other RF screens that call rf() on focus or mount with uid ''. (2) In client.ts rapidAccess: return or wait when userId is empty instead of exchanging; use `await grantFlight.catch(() => {})` at line 293 so a sibling flight's error does not reach other callers; move the generation check before the throw at line 303. Re-test with 5 hard reloads of /rapid/cup/<cid> while watching for the text.
MINOR: shorten or let 'SEE MY CROWN' and 'JOIN CUP NIGHT' shrink at 320 px (numberOfLines/adjustsFontSizeToFit or a shorter label).
MINOR: show a numeric countdown during the 30 s Cup Night round-1 lead-in on the duel screen.
critical_code_review_comments: client.ts:291-308: the generation check runs only after a successful-looking response, so mismatch or 401 throws during a session change are still shown to the user. Callers awaiting an existing grantFlight receive its rejection.
[cid].tsx:104: useFocusEffect load() runs before the auth uid is ready (the poll effect has a guard, the focus effect does not).

cups.py: title_no comes from the atomic $inc result (cups_won after the increment), with a count_documents fallback. This is correct and concurrency-safe. night_guard is applied to both create and join, and NIGHT_LEAD only applies when c.night is set and rnd == 0. Verified.

success_rate.frontend: about 90% (all requested flows pass except the hard-load session-error text)

seed_data_creation: None kept. 3 QA cups (2 won Open Cups + 1 lobby cup) and 1 QA night cup were created, with 5 duels, 4 rf_awards and 13 rf_feed 'duel:*' rows; tonight's rf_cup_nights doc was created twice. All were removed by exact ids or prefixes of the duel ids I created. The QA rf_profile (coins 118, xp 260, level, badges, exam_stats, week_stats, etc.) was restored by replacing the full document from a snapshot taken before the tests. TEST-i65 pytest users were cleaned up by the fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via /entry (entry-phone-input, entry-pin-input, entry-continue-button) with keyboard.type, then save the full localStorage to /tmp/iter66_ls.json and inject it with add_init_script guarded by a sessionStorage flag (so rf.crown keys survive reloads). Crown flow: run `python backend/tests/_iter65_crown.py watch &`, then press cup-create. Restore with `python backend/tests/_iter66_snapshot.py save` (before) and `restore` (after); it removes new QA cups, duels, awards and duel feed and puts the profile back. For night: `_iter65_night_ctl.py doors`, then `_iter66_night_at.py <sec>` to move the start, then `_iter65_night_ctl.py restore`. Run the snapshot restore before the night restore (night_ctl does not delete duels).
rca_of_issue: Session error text on hard load: auth user starts null → [cid] focus effect calls rf() with uid '' → rapidAccess('') → /rf/access 200 with the real user_id → mismatch throw → the shared grantFlight rejection also reaches the real-uid call → error visible until the next 2 s poll. Repro: sign in, open /rapid/cup/<cid>, press reload, and watch the body text from 1 to 3 s. Fix: guard on uid, ignore a sibling flight's error, and skip the exchange for an empty userId.
